observe.invite-code-invalid.en: Invite codes have 6 letters and numbers. Check it, or leave it blank.
observe.invite-code-invalid.ha: Lambar gayyata tana da haruffa da lambobi 6. Duba ta, ko ka bar ta fanko.
observe.invite-code-invalid.ig: Koodu ọkpụkpọ nwere mkpụrụedemede na ọnụọgụ 6. Lelee ya, ma ọ bụ hapụ ya oghere.
observe.invite-code-invalid.yo: Kóòdù ìpè ní lẹ́tà àti nọ́mbà 6. Ṣàyẹ̀wò rẹ̀, tàbí fi òfìfo sílẹ̀.

invite.open-in-app.en: Already have the app? Open it
invite.open-in-app.ig: Ị nwere ngwa ahụ? Mepee ya
invite.open-in-app.yo: Ṣé o ti ní ohun-èlò náà? Ṣí i
